consequence.statement: Existing ClusterExternalSecret objects stored as v1beta1 must be rewritten via storage version migration before a later release removes v1beta1 support; status.storedVersions must be updated.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration to rewrite all ClusterExternalSecret objects and update status.storedVersions before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1; existing objects remain stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration rewrites them.
